name: Fake Mute Deafen
description: Show other people that you are muted, deafened or have your camera on while you can still talk and hear. A button in the user panel, entries in the voice device menus, two key shortcuts and optional slash commands. Changes what Discord tells the others about your voice state.

credits.name: Vendicated and contributors (Vencord), plugin FakeMuteDeafen by x2b, dot, sirphantom89 and hyyven
